newsitem.title: USA: Innovo Group doubles Tenn. sewing capacity.
newsitem.headline: Innovo Group doubles Tenn. sewing capacity.

text.p: Innovo Group Inc said Friday a newly leased sewing facility in Red Boiling Springs should eliminate labor shortages and double its Tennessee operations.
The company said the lease is 36 months and that operations should begin at the facility next month.
The company said rent on the building would have no noticeable effect on operating expenses and added that it is still seeking an additional plant to meet projected January 1997 orders.

In August the company said it expected to report a 44 percent increase in third quarter sales despite labor shortages that had limited production, cut into its ability to accept new orders and slowed development on new lines of ladies' sleep wear and lounge wear.
An Innovo spokesman said later that the leased facility could help double 1997 revenues.
"We will end up this year with about $8 million in revenues and we're anticipating the possibility of doubling them in FY '97," said spokesman Kirk Miller.
For fiscal 1995 the company reported narrowing its losses to $0.36 per share from a fiscal 1994 loss of $3.98 per share. In the second quarter this year it reported a $0.04 per share loss.
Innovo is scheduled to report third quarter earnings on Monday, Miller said.
